newsitem.title: POLAND: Prochem, Mostostal K in deal.
newsitem.headline: Prochem, Mostostal K in deal.

text.p: Polish engineering firm Prochem SA and builders Mostosal Krakow SA and Mostostal Siedlce SA signed a contract on Wednesday to cooperate in marketing, investment and bidding for large contracts, the firms' presidents said.

"(Firm representatives) will meet every month or six weeks to decide on joint operations such as submitting joint bids for large projects," Prochem president Stanislaw Srokowski told a news conference.
He told Reuters afterwards large projects were between 50 and 100 million zlotys.
Mostostal Siedlce president Aleksander Jonek said his firm planned no public offering but would start trade on the main market of the Warsaw bourse as early as the end of this year's third quarter.

He said Mostostal Siedlce made a net profit last year of 3.4 million zlotys on sales of 160 million zlotys after making hefty provisions and would earn 10 million zlotys this year on sales of 170 million zlotys.

The firms' presidents said their first move was the purchase of builder Mostostal Stalowa Wola SA, with each of the three having agreed to pay 2.5 million zlotys in a capital raise for each to hold just over 25 percent of Stalowa Wola.
Jonek said Stalowa Wola made a net profit of 0.4 million zlotys last year on sales of 40 million zlotys.

Srokowski and Jonek as well as Mostostal Krakow president Stanislaw Osieka said there were no immediate plans for the three firms to merge in the face of tough domestic and foreign competition but that such a move was possible in future.
